messages:
alex_support: Customer reporting streaming responses cut off early when using our TS SDK in a Next.js edge function (Edge runtime). Happens ~15s in, ReadableStream closes, also saw intermittent 401s and duplicate billing increments. Minimal repro included.

devon: can you paste the minimal repro and SDK version? also which deploy platform (vercel/edge-runner/cloudflare)?

alex_support: Vercel Edge, node toolchain: Next 13 edge, using @redwood/inference-js v0.6.1. Repro: call `client.chat.stream()` inside an edge function, pipe stream to Response. Sometimes ends early and client console shows `ReadableStream closed`. 401 logs appear in platform logs right before close. Billing shows two short requests counted.

sre-liz: @alex_support can you include the request-id from the 401 and the full server logs around the time? might be a short-lived auth token refresh hitting a retry path.

alex_support: request-id: r-0a1b2c3d; logs: `auth: 401 token expired`, then our middleware retries and a second successful 200 appears. Attached in chat: stack snippet.

support-bot: Attached logs from infra: 
```
2026-02-28T12:10:02Z r-0a1b2c3d 401 /v1/chat/stream
2026-02-28T12:10:03Z r-0a1b2c3d retry 1 -> 200 /v1/chat/stream
```

ashley: sounds like the SDK's automatic retry may be triggering a second request while the original stream reader is still open. In edge runtimes you can't safely multiplex two streaming responses on the same client. Workaround: disable automatic retry for streaming calls or ensure retries happen before the stream handshake.

devon: which retry config are you using? default? If the SDK retries on auth failure, the first (failed) request may still produce an early close event that the app observes. We should special-case 401 for streaming calls to not auto-retry.

pm-raj: also saw billing duplicate increments when the server receives two requests in short succession; our billing pipeline counts start-of-stream events. If retry happens after a transient 401, both attempts may be billed. Need to debounce billing on identical request-ids where possible.

alex_support: repro code: 
```
// edge-function.ts (Next edge)
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'
export const runtime = 'edge'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
export default async (req) => {
  const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-1', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'hello'}] })
  return new Response(stream) // sometimes ends after ~15s
}
```

dev-support: pls try this quick change in the app: `client.chat.stream({ ..., retry: 0 })` or set `maxRetries: 0` in global config and see if behaviour stops. If it does, that points to retry overlap.

alex_support: tested `retry: 0` — stream no longer cuts off early in multiple runs. 401 still shows once but no double-billing. Good sign.

ashley: ok that's confirming. We should ship a patch to the SDK where streaming endpoints opt out of automatic retries (or implement a pre-flight auth check before opening stream). I'll open a PR to treat 4xx as non-retriable for streaming methods.

devon: for customers who can't upgrade immediately, doc workaround: in edge runtimes set `retry: 0` for streaming calls; additionally, handle auth proactively by exchanging short-lived tokens server-side and avoiding late refresh during a stream.

alex_support: one more oddity — some customers use web-streams-polyfill in node, could that interact? We're on edge runtime so native web streams used. But noted.

devon: polyfills can change stream lifecycle events; ask customers to remove polyfill when running in edge. Also check they aren't calling `response.body.cancel()` prematurely.

pm-raj: I'll file a billing ticket to consider deduping start-of-stream billing within a 2s window for identical request fingerprints.

support-bot: Issue created: INF-12345 (SDK: streaming non-retriable + billing dedupe).

devon: follow-ups: 1) patch SDK to disable retries for streaming methods (PR in progress), 2) add guidance in docs about edge runtimes and streaming, 3) billing dedupe evaluation.

alex_support: communicating workaround and ETA to customer. Thanks all :thumbsup:

devon: tagging @sre-liz for infra audit; we'll want to ensure 401+retry pattern can't cause request duplication under heavy load.

sre-liz: will audit logs and rate-limiter hooks tomorrow.

alex_support: closing thread after customer confirms stable with `retry: 0`.
